layout: Mirror of Aurora-WebUI relative paths: vendor/webui/<path> is a verbatim copy of Aurora-WebUI/<path> except for the seams below. Relative imports resolve unchanged.
generated: descriptors.json (via gen-descriptors.py from core + Hue + Input descriptor tables)
notes: icon-paths: NavFooter.js + Dropdown.js page-relative icons/*.svg rewritten to vendor/webui/icons/* (CSS mask urls resolve relatively and needed no change)
string-zone-ids: ZoneActiveToggle.js Number(dataset.zoneId) replaced with type-tolerant lookup + unknown-id guard (native ids are uint8; demo room ids are strings)

toggle-sync: ZoneActiveToggleList.onChange + ZoneCanvas.onActiveChange/refreshActive keep Bridge and Zone Mapping bools on the same shared objects in sync; DashboardScreen wires both directions (upstream has no sibling consumer, so no callbacks exist there)

seams.note: Line 383 navigates to OutputConnectScreen (NUX bridge setup). Never reachable in the demo: the shim answers /api/hue/connection as configured:true. OutputConnectScreen.js is vendored dead so the import resolves; it is never mounted.

Uses only pickVideoInputName/pickAudioInputName from ModeDeviceScreen.js (DashboardScreen.js:453-454); the ModeDeviceScreen class itself is unused here. ModeDeviceScreen.js is vendored dead so the import resolves; it is never mounted.

Bare html/body rules (shell.css:18,23) and the * reset would leak onto the demo scene page. On vendoring, wrap them in the dashboard-pane scope class; re-apply on every re-vendor. Tokens (--aurora-*) and prefixed classes need no change.
Decided: no Stop button in the port. The vendored copy drops the trailingButton wiring (DashboardScreen.js:118-122). POST /api/stop needs no shim route.

DashboardScreen takes an app object (this.app.navigate). app.js/shell.js are NOT vendored; the demo boot provides a minimal facade. Only navigate() needs to exist, and no reachable path calls it (seam no-output-connect).
